text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The immense pressure from Oguri and the 
others kept me from running the race the 
way I wanted...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Will you be running in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And so, I will defeat you.

Mejiro Ardan and Oguri Cap renew their vow 
to face each other once more. And with 
that, the Mainichi Okan came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The place Yaeno-san specified should be 
right here, but... it seems she hasn't 
arrived yet.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here, Ardan-san? Where is 
Yaeno-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It appears Yaeno-san called the 
two of us here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming all this way. I 
called you both here today because there's 
something I wanted to give to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that... the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—In the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
Oguri-san will be competing as well.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With Oguri-san, the core of the Eternal 
Big Three, joining us, let this race 
settle our score once and for all—and 
decide who stands at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And... shall we make it known to the 
world?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That we are the true Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. That was such a wonderful 
suggestion that I couldn't help showing my 
delight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let us settle our score once and for all 
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I accept this challenge as well! And 
then... let us compete for the top!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's what makes you worthy rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(At "this" very moment, I am reminded once 
again.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That I truly am... a blessed soul.)
